provenance.derivation: Named idealized habit presets use documented forms. Development values, disabled forms and preferred views are curated visualization choices, not measured growth or surface-energy parameters.

Appearance presets use curated visualization parameters for indigo-blue and golden-brown anatase, both colors reported for the mineral. The supported metallic category represents the source's reported luster range, including metallic; it does not assert that every anatase specimen is metallic. Numeric values are not measured optical constants.

appearanceClaims.description: Anatase is reported brown, yellow, reddish brown, indigo, black, pale green, pale lilac, gray, and rarely nearly colorless.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: The colour range does not define a measured renderer colour.

appearanceClaims.description: Anatase ranges from transparent when light coloured to nearly opaque when deeply coloured.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: Diaphaneity does not directly determine the curated transmission value.

appearanceClaims.description: Anatase luster ranges from adamantine to splendent or metallic.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: The current luster vocabulary has no adamantine or splendent category, and a material mapping needs review.

appearanceClaims.description: Some pyramidal anatase crystals from the documented Colorado material have closely spaced striations parallel to basal-pinacoid edges.
appearanceClaims.dispositionReason: The report is locality-specific and does not resolve a pyramid family or a renderer direction in the shipped basis.

habits.name: Dipyramidal
habits.description: Eight triangular dipyramid faces; the ideal untruncated endmember.

habits.name: Tabular
habits.description: Basal faces dominate a plate bounded at its edges by dipyramid faces.
